AfterObtained.rationale: STALE at round 11: the only guard this rollup names, G1, was already closed 2026-07-27 per this same record's own guards[G1] entry. EXECUTED (this pass): mango.py:31 reads `run.hp = max(1, run.hp - self._healed)` -- an explicit SUBTRACTION of the recorded heal (floored at 1 HP, not clamped to max_hp) -- followed by `run.lose_max_hp(self.MAX_HP)` at :33, which is exactly the fixed shape G1's own text describes ('the undo SUBTRACTS the heal instead of clamping'). The forward direction (guard N1) was already faithful. Both halves of AfterObtained are faithful, so the rollup is too.

guards.what: G1 (LIVE): `undo_after_obtained` (mango.py:21-25) does NOT give back the heal, contradicting its own comment, so a speculatively-granted-then-dropped Mango leaves up to 14 HP behind
guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: the undo SUBTRACTS the heal instead of clamping. sts2_rl/relics/mango.py's after_obtained (MAX_HP 14) records the HP the grant actually healed in `_healed` and `undo_after_obtained` does `run.hp = max(1, run.hp - self._healed)` BEFORE `run.lose_max_hp(...)`, so the pair is exact from a damaged player as well as a full one. WAS: the undo called lose_max_hp and then re-clamped `run.hp = min(run.hp, run.max_hp)`, which gives back nothing whenever the post-heal HP is at or below the restored maximum -- the common case -- leaving the conformance runner's relic resync reading high for the rest of the run.

guards.rationale: 14 is the pinned non-ascension value -- no AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension call anywhere in Mango.cs -- and `.BaseValue` is the unmodified var, so no hook can change it. run.gain_max_hp (run.py:311-314) is CreatureCmd.GainMaxHp's exact shape: `SetMaxHp(MaxHp + amount)` then `Heal(num)` where num is the max-HP delta actually applied (CreatureCmd.cs:792-798). EXECUTED: 80 -> 94 max, 50 -> 64 current. The MapPointHistoryEntry.MaxHpGained bookkeeping (CreatureCmd.cs:793-797) is replay history, not state.
